  }

  Widget _buildToggleButton(
    BuildContext context,
    String label,
    bool isSelected,
    VoidCallback onTap,
    Color color,
  ) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppDesignTokens.radiusMedium),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: AppDesignTokens.space12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? color : Colors.grey.shade200,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppDesignTokens.radiusMedium),
        ),
        child: Center(
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
                  color: isSelected ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIHaveDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    AsyncValue<List<Account>> accountsAsync,
    double total,
  ) {
    return accountsAsync.when(
      data: (accounts) {
        // Filter out Credit Card accounts
        final regularAccounts = accounts
            .where((a) => a.type.toLowerCase() != 'credit card')
            .toList();

        if (regularAccounts.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }

        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
          ),
          child: Card(
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: () {
                // TODO: Navigate to accounts screen
              },
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppDesignTokens.space16),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      Icons.account_balance,
                      color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                      size: 32,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: AppDesignTokens.space16),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            'Accounts',
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Text(
                            NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ').format(total),
                            style: Theme.of(context)
                                .textTheme
                                .bodyMedium
                                ?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    Icon(
                      Icons.chevron_right,
                      color: Colors.grey.shade400,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
      loading: () => const SizedBox.shrink(),
      error: (_, __) => const SizedBox.shrink(),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIOweDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    double total,
  ) {
    final creditCardDebtAsync = ref.watch(debtListProvider('i_owe'));
    final creditCardDebt = creditCardDebtAsync.when(
      data: (debts) {
        return debts
            .where((d) => d.note == 'Credit Card Debt')
            .fold<double>(
              0.0,
              (sum, debt) => sum + (debt.amount - debt.paidAmount),
            );
      },
      loading: () => 0.0,
      error: (_, __) => 0.0,
    );

    final regularDebtTotal = total - creditCardDebt;

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          if (creditCardDebt > 0)
            Card(
              child: InkWell(
                onTap: () {
                  // TODO: Navigate to credit cards
                },
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppDesignTokens.space16),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.credit_card,
                        color: Colors.orange.shade700,
                        size: 32,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: AppDesignTokens.space16),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              'Credit cards',
                              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 4),
                            Text(
                              NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                                  .format(creditCardDebt),
                              style: Theme.of(context)
                                  .textTheme
                                  .bodyMedium
                                  ?.copyWith(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      Icon(
                        Icons.chevron_right,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade400,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (creditCardDebt > 0 && regularDebtTotal > 0)
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space12),
          if (regularDebtTotal > 0)
            Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppDesignTokens.space16),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                      color: Colors.red.shade700,
                      size: 32,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: AppDesignTokens.space16),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            'Other debts',
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Text(
                            NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                                .format(regularDebtTotal),
                            style: Theme.of(context)
                                .textTheme
                                .bodyMedium
                                ?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDebtList(String type) {
    if (type == 'i_have') {
      // Show accounts list
      final accountsAsync = ref.watch(accountListProvider);
      return accountsAsync.when(
        data: (accounts) {
          final regularAccounts = accounts
              .where((a) => a.type.toLowerCase() != 'credit card')
              .toList();

          if (regularAccounts.isEmpty) {
            return RefreshIndicator(
              onRefresh: () async {
                ref.invalidate(accountListProvider);
              },
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                child: SizedBox(
                  height: 400,
                  child: EmptyStateWidget(
                    icon: Icons.account_balance,
                    title: 'No accounts yet.',
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          }

          return RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: () async {
              ref.invalidate(accountListProvider);
            },
            child: ListView.builder(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
                vertical: AppDesignTokens.space8,
              ),
              physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              cacheExtent: 500,
              itemCount: regularAccounts.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final account = regularAccounts[index];
                return Card(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: AppDesignTokens.space8),
                  child: ListTile(
                    leading: Icon(
                      Icons.account_balance,
                      color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                    ),
                    title: Text(account.name),
                    subtitle: Text(account.type),
                    trailing: Text(
                      NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                          .format(account.balance),
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: account.balance >= 0
                                ? Colors.green
                                : Colors.red,
                          ),
                    ),
                    onTap: () {
                      Navigator.of(context).push(
                        MaterialPageRoute(
                          builder: (context) =>
                              AccountDetailScreen(account: account),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          );
        },
        loading: () => SkeletonList.cards(itemCount: 6),
        error: (error, stack) => ErrorStateWidget(
          message: error.toString(),
          onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(accountListProvider),
        ),
      );
    }

    // Show debts list
    final debtsAsync = ref.watch(debtListProvider(type));

    return debtsAsync.when(
      data: (debts) {
        if (debts.isEmpty) {
          return RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: () async {
              ref.invalidate(debtListProvider(type));
            },
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              child: SizedBox(
                height: 400,
                child: EmptyStateWidget(
                  icon: Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                  title: type == 'i_owe'
                      ? 'No debts to pay. Great job!'
                      : 'No one owes you money.',
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }

        return RefreshIndicator(
          onRefresh: () async {
            ref.invalidate(debtListProvider(type));
          },
          child: ListView.builder(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
              vertical: AppDesignTokens.space8,
            ),
            physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            cacheExtent: 500,
            itemCount: debts.length,
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final debt = debts[index];
              final isCreditCardDebt = debt.note == 'Credit Card Debt';

              return Dismissible(
                key: Key('debt_${debt.id ?? 'credit_card_${debt.person}'}'),
                direction: isCreditCardDebt
                    ? DismissDirection.none
                    : DismissDirection.endToStart,
                background: Container(
                  alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd,
                  padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(
                      end: AppDesignTokens.space20),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                    borderRadius:
                        BorderRadius.circular(AppDesignTokens.radiusMedium),
                  ),
                  child: Icon(
                    Icons.delete,
                    color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onError,
                    size: 32,
                  ),
                ),
                confirmDismiss: isCreditCardDebt
                    ? null
                    : (direction) async {
                        return await showDialog<bool>(
                              context: context,
                              builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
                                title: const Text('Delete Debt'),
                                content: const Text(
                                  'Are you sure you want to delete this debt?',
                                ),
                                actions: [
                                  TextButton(
                                    onPressed: () =>
                                        Navigator.of(context).pop(false),
                                    child: const Text('Cancel'),
                                  ),
                                  TextButton(
                                    onPressed: () =>
                                        Navigator.of(context).pop(true),
                                    style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                                      foregroundColor:
                                          Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                                    ),
                                    child: const Text('Delete'),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ) ??
                            false;
                      },
                onDismissed: isCreditCardDebt
                    ? null
                    : (direction) {
                        _deleteDebt(context, debt);
                      },
                child: DebtListItem(
                  debt: debt,
                  onTap: () {
                    if (isCreditCardDebt) {
                      _showCreditCardAccount(context, debt.person);
                    } else {
                      _showDebtDetail(context, debt);
                    }
                  },
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        );
      },
      loading: () => SkeletonList.cards(itemCount: 6),
      error: (error, stack) => ErrorStateWidget(
        message: error.toString(),
        onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(debtListProvider(type)),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showAddDebtDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => const AddDebtDialog(),
    );
  }

  void _showDebtDetail(BuildContext context, Debt debt) {
    context.push(
      AppRoutes.debtDetail,
      extra: debt,
    );
  }

  void _deleteDebt(BuildContext context, Debt debt) {
    if (debt.id == null) return;

    ref
        .read(debtNotifierProvider.notifier)
        .deleteDebtEntry(debt.id!, debt.type);
    FeedbackService.showSuccess(context, 'Debt deleted');
  }

  void _showCreditCardAccount(BuildContext context, String accountName) {
    final accountsAsync = ref.read(accountListProvider);
    accountsAsync.whenData((accounts) {
      final creditCardAccount = accounts.firstWhere(
        (account) =>
            account.type == 'Credit Card' && account.name == accountName,
        orElse: () => accounts.firstWhere(
          (account) => account.type == 'Credit Card',
        ),
      );
      Navigator.of(context).push(
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (context) => AccountDetailScreen(account: creditCardAccount),
        ),
      );
    });
  }
}

  Widget _buildToggleButton(

  Widget _buildIHaveDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    AsyncValue<List<Account>> accountsAsync,
    double total,
  ) {
    return accountsAsync.when(
      data: (accounts) {
        // Filter out Credit Card accounts
        final regularAccounts = accounts
            .where((a) => a.type.toLowerCase() != 'credit card')
            .toList();

        if (regularAccounts.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }

        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
          ),
          child: Card(
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: () {
                // TODO: Navigate to accounts screen
              },
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppDesignTokens.space16),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      Icons.account_balance,
                      color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                      size: 32,

  Widget _buildIOweDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    double total,
  ) {
    final creditCardDebtAsync = ref.watch(debtListProvider('i_owe'));
    final creditCardDebt = creditCardDebtAsync.when(
      data: (debts) {
        return debts
            .where((d) => d.note == 'Credit Card Debt')
            .fold<double>(
              0.0,
              (sum, debt) => sum + (debt.amount - debt.paidAmount),
            );
      },
      loading: () => 0.0,
      error: (_, __) => 0.0,
    );

    final regularDebtTotal = total - creditCardDebt;

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          if (creditCardDebt > 0)
            Card(
              child: InkWell(
                onTap: () {

                      ),
                      Icon(
                        Icons.chevron_right,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade400,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (creditCardDebt > 0 && regularDebtTotal > 0)
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space12),
          if (regularDebtTotal > 0)
            Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppDesignTokens.space16),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                      color: Colors.red.shade700,
                      size: 32,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: AppDesignTokens.space16),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            'Other debts',
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Text(
                            NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                                .format(regularDebtTotal),
                            style: Theme.of(context)
                                .textTheme
                                .bodyMedium
                                ?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDebtList(String type) {
    if (type == 'i_have') {
      // Show accounts list
      final accountsAsync = ref.watch(accountListProvider);
      return accountsAsync.when(
        data: (accounts) {
          final regularAccounts = accounts
              .where((a) => a.type.toLowerCase() != 'credit card')
              .toList();

          if (regularAccounts.isEmpty) {
            return RefreshIndicator(
              onRefresh: () async {
                ref.invalidate(accountListProvider);
              },
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                child: SizedBox(
                  height: 400,
                  child: EmptyStateWidget(
                    icon: Icons.account_balance,
                    title: 'No accounts yet.',
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          }

          return RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: () async {
              ref.invalidate(accountListProvider);
            },
            child: ListView.builder(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
                vertical: AppDesignTokens.space8,
              ),
              physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              cacheExtent: 500,
              itemCount: regularAccounts.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final account = regularAccounts[index];
                return Card(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: AppDesignTokens.space8),
                  child: ListTile(
                    leading: Icon(
                      Icons.account_balance,
                      color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                    ),
                    title: Text(account.name),
                    subtitle: Text(account.type),
                    trailing: Text(
                      NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                          .format(account.balance),
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: account.balance >= 0
                                ? Colors.green
                                : Colors.red,
                          ),
                    ),
                    onTap: () {
                      Navigator.of(context).push(
                        MaterialPageRoute(
                          builder: (context) =>
                              AccountDetailScreen(account: account),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          );
        },
        loading: () => SkeletonList.cards(itemCount: 6),
        error: (error, stack) => ErrorStateWidget(
          message: error.toString(),
          onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(accountListProvider),
        ),
      );
    }

    // Show debts list
    final debtsAsync = ref.watch(debtListProvider(type));

    return debtsAsync.when(
      data: (debts) {
        if (debts.isEmpty) {
          return RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: () async {
              ref.invalidate(debtListProvider(type));
            },
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              child: SizedBox(
                height: 400,
                child: EmptyStateWidget(
                  icon: Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                  title: type == 'i_owe'
                      ? 'No debts to pay. Great job!'
                      : 'No one owes you money.',
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }

        return RefreshIndicator(
          onRefresh: () async {
            ref.invalidate(debtListProvider(type));
          },
          child: ListView.builder(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
              vertical: AppDesignTokens.space8,
            ),
            physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            cacheExtent: 500,
            itemCount: debts.length,
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final debt = debts[index];
              final isCreditCardDebt = debt.note == 'Credit Card Debt';

              return Dismissible(
                key: Key('debt_${debt.id ?? 'credit_card_${debt.person}'}'),
                direction: isCreditCardDebt
                    ? DismissDirection.none
                    : DismissDirection.endToStart,
                background: Container(
                  alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd,
                  padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(
                      end: AppDesignTokens.space20),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                    borderRadius:
                        BorderRadius.circular(AppDesignTokens.radiusMedium),
                  ),
                  child: Icon(
                    Icons.delete,
                    color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onError,
                    size: 32,
                  ),
                ),
                confirmDismiss: isCreditCardDebt
                    ? null
                    : (direction) async {
                        return await showDialog<bool>(
                              context: context,
                              builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
                                title: const Text('Delete Debt'),
                                content: const Text(
                                  'Are you sure you want to delete this debt?',
                                ),
                                actions: [
                                  TextButton(
                                    onPressed: () =>
                                        Navigator.of(context).pop(false),
                                    child: const Text('Cancel'),
                                  ),
                                  TextButton(
                                    onPressed: () =>
                                        Navigator.of(context).pop(true),
                                    style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                                      foregroundColor:
                                          Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                                    ),
                                    child: const Text('Delete'),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ) ??
                            false;
                      },
                onDismissed: isCreditCardDebt
                    ? null
                    : (direction) {
                        _deleteDebt(context, debt);
                      },
                child: DebtListItem(
                  debt: debt,
                  onTap: () {
                    if (isCreditCardDebt) {
                      _showCreditCardAccount(context, debt.person);
                    } else {
                      _showDebtDetail(context, debt);
                    }
                  },
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        );
      },
      loading: () => SkeletonList.cards(itemCount: 6),
      error: (error, stack) => ErrorStateWidget(
        message: error.toString(),
        onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(debtListProvider(type)),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showAddDebtDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => const AddDebtDialog(),
    );
  }

  void _showDebtDetail(BuildContext context, Debt debt) {
    context.push(
      AppRoutes.debtDetail,
      extra: debt,
    );
  }

  void _deleteDebt(BuildContext context, Debt debt) {
    if (debt.id == null) return;

    ref
        .read(debtNotifierProvider.notifier)
        .deleteDebtEntry(debt.id!, debt.type);
    FeedbackService.showSuccess(context, 'Debt deleted');
  }

  void _showCreditCardAccount(BuildContext context, String accountName) {
    final accountsAsync = ref.read(accountListProvider);
    accountsAsync.whenData((accounts) {
      final creditCardAccount = accounts.firstWhere(
        (account) =>
            account.type == 'Credit Card' && account.name == accountName,
        orElse: () => accounts.firstWhere(
          (account) => account.type == 'Credit Card',
        ),
      );
      Navigator.of(context).push(
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (context) => AccountDetailScreen(account: creditCardAccount),
        ),
      );
    });
  }
}

                              bottomLeft: const Radius.circular(4),
                              topRight: iOwePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                              bottomRight: iOwePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Expanded(
                        flex: (iOwePercentage * 100).round().clamp(1, 100),
                        child: Container(
                          height: 8,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.red,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
                              topRight: const Radius.circular(4),
                              bottomRight: const Radius.circular(4),
                              topLeft: iHavePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                              bottomLeft: iHavePercentage == 0

                                  .textTheme
                                  .titleMedium
                                  ?.copyWith(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                  ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 6),
                            Icon(
                              Icons.info_outline,
                              size: 18,
                              color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        Text(
                          NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                              .format(netWorth),

                    child: _buildToggleButton(

            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
            // Total amount card
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
              ),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,

                      'Total amount in ${DateFormat('d MMM yyyy').format(DateTime.now())}',

                      NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ').format(

                      ),

                          .textTheme
                          .titleMedium
                          ?.copyWith(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
            // Detail Cards
            if (_selectedView == 'i_have')
              _buildIHaveDetails(context, accountsAsync, iHave)
            else
              _buildIOweDetails(context, iOwe),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),

            Padding(

                horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
              ),

                _selectedView == 'i_have' ? 'Accounts' : 'Debts',

            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space8),

  Widget _buildToggleButton(
    BuildContext context,
    String label,
    bool isSelected,
    VoidCallback onTap,
    Color color,
  ) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? color : Colors.grey.shade300,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Center(
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.normal,
                  color: isSelected ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIHaveDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    AsyncValue<List<Account>> accountsAsync,
    double total,
  ) {
    return accountsAsync.when(
      data: (accounts) {
        // Filter out Credit Card accounts
        final regularAccounts = accounts
            .where((a) => a.type.toLowerCase() != 'credit card')
            .toList();

        if (regularAccounts.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }

        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
          ),
          child: Card(
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: () {
                // TODO: Navigate to accounts screen
              },
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppDesignTokens.space16),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      Icons.account_balance,
                      color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                      size: 32,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: AppDesignTokens.space16),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            'Accounts',
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Text(
                            NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ').format(total),
                            style: Theme.of(context)
                                .textTheme
                                .bodyMedium
                                ?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    Icon(
                      Icons.chevron_right,
                      color: Colors.grey.shade400,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
      loading: () => const SizedBox.shrink(),
      error: (_, __) => const SizedBox.shrink(),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIOweDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    double total,
  ) {
    final creditCardDebtAsync = ref.watch(debtListProvider('i_owe'));
    final creditCardDebt = creditCardDebtAsync.when(
      data: (debts) {
        return debts
            .where((d) => d.note == 'Credit Card Debt')
            .fold<double>(
              0.0,
              (sum, debt) => sum + (debt.amount - debt.paidAmount),
            );
      },
      loading: () => 0.0,
      error: (_, __) => 0.0,
    );

    final regularDebtTotal = total - creditCardDebt;

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          if (creditCardDebt > 0)
            Card(
              child: InkWell(
                onTap: () {
                  // TODO: Navigate to credit cards
                },
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppDesignTokens.space16),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.credit_card,
                        color: Colors.orange.shade700,
                        size: 32,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: AppDesignTokens.space16),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              'Credit cards',
                              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 4),
                            Text(
                              NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                                  .format(creditCardDebt),
                              style: Theme.of(context)
                                  .textTheme
                                  .bodyMedium
                                  ?.copyWith(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      Icon(
                        Icons.chevron_right,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade400,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (creditCardDebt > 0 && regularDebtTotal > 0)
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space12),
          if (regularDebtTotal > 0)
            Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppDesignTokens.space16),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                      color: Colors.red.shade700,
                      size: 32,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: AppDesignTokens.space16),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            'Other debts',
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Text(
                            NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                                .format(regularDebtTotal),
                            style: Theme.of(context)
                                .textTheme
                                .bodyMedium
                                ?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDebtList(String type) {
    if (type == 'i_have') {
      // Show accounts list
      final accountsAsync = ref.watch(accountListProvider);
      return accountsAsync.when(
        data: (accounts) {
          final regularAccounts = accounts
              .where((a) => a.type.toLowerCase() != 'credit card')
              .toList();

          if (regularAccounts.isEmpty) {
            return RefreshIndicator(
              onRefresh: () async {
                ref.invalidate(accountListProvider);
              },
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                child: SizedBox(
                  height: 400,
                  child: EmptyStateWidget(
                    icon: Icons.account_balance,
                    title: 'No accounts yet.',
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          }

          return RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: () async {
              ref.invalidate(accountListProvider);
            },
            child: ListView.builder(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
                vertical: AppDesignTokens.space8,
              ),
              physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              cacheExtent: 500,
              itemCount: regularAccounts.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final account = regularAccounts[index];
                return Card(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: AppDesignTokens.space8),
                  child: ListTile(
                    leading: Icon(
                      Icons.account_balance,
                      color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                    ),
                    title: Text(account.name),
                    subtitle: Text(account.type),
                    trailing: Text(
                      NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                          .format(account.balance),
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: account.balance >= 0
                                ? Colors.green
                                : Colors.red,
                          ),
                    ),
                    onTap: () {
                      Navigator.of(context).push(
                        MaterialPageRoute(
                          builder: (context) =>
                              AccountDetailScreen(account: account),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          );
        },
        loading: () => SkeletonList.cards(itemCount: 6),
        error: (error, stack) => ErrorStateWidget(
          message: error.toString(),
          onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(accountListProvider),
        ),
      );
    }

    // Show debts list
    final debtsAsync = ref.watch(debtListProvider(type));

    return debtsAsync.when(
      data: (debts) {
        if (debts.isEmpty) {
          return RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: () async {
              ref.invalidate(debtListProvider(type));
            },
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              child: SizedBox(
                height: 400,
                child: EmptyStateWidget(
                  icon: Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                  title: type == 'i_owe'
                      ? 'No debts to pay. Great job!'
                      : 'No one owes you money.',
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }

        return RefreshIndicator(
          onRefresh: () async {
            ref.invalidate(debtListProvider(type));
          },
          child: ListView.builder(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
              vertical: AppDesignTokens.space8,
            ),
            physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            cacheExtent: 500,
            itemCount: debts.length,
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final debt = debts[index];
              final isCreditCardDebt = debt.note == 'Credit Card Debt';

              return Dismissible(
                key: Key('debt_${debt.id ?? 'credit_card_${debt.person}'}'),
                direction: isCreditCardDebt
                    ? DismissDirection.none
                    : DismissDirection.endToStart,
                background: Container(
                  alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd,
                  padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(
                      end: AppDesignTokens.space20),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                    borderRadius:
                        BorderRadius.circular(AppDesignTokens.radiusMedium),
                  ),
                  child: Icon(
                    Icons.delete,
                    color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onError,
                    size: 32,
                  ),
                ),
                confirmDismiss: isCreditCardDebt
                    ? null
                    : (direction) async {
                        return await showDialog<bool>(
                              context: context,
                              builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
                                title: const Text('Delete Debt'),
                                content: const Text(
                                  'Are you sure you want to delete this debt?',
                                ),
                                actions: [
                                  TextButton(
                                    onPressed: () =>
                                        Navigator.of(context).pop(false),
                                    child: const Text('Cancel'),
                                  ),
                                  TextButton(
                                    onPressed: () =>
                                        Navigator.of(context).pop(true),
                                    style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                                      foregroundColor:
                                          Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                                    ),
                                    child: const Text('Delete'),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ) ??
                            false;
                      },
                onDismissed: isCreditCardDebt
                    ? null
                    : (direction) {
                        _deleteDebt(context, debt);
                      },
                child: DebtListItem(
                  debt: debt,
                  onTap: () {
                    if (isCreditCardDebt) {
                      _showCreditCardAccount(context, debt.person);
                    } else {
                      _showDebtDetail(context, debt);
                    }
                  },
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        );
      },
      loading: () => SkeletonList.cards(itemCount: 6),
      error: (error, stack) => ErrorStateWidget(
        message: error.toString(),
        onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(debtListProvider(type)),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showAddDebtDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => const AddDebtDialog(),
    );
  }

  void _showDebtDetail(BuildContext context, Debt debt) {
    context.push(
      AppRoutes.debtDetail,
      extra: debt,
    );
  }

  void _deleteDebt(BuildContext context, Debt debt) {
    if (debt.id == null) return;

    ref
        .read(debtNotifierProvider.notifier)
        .deleteDebtEntry(debt.id!, debt.type);
    FeedbackService.showSuccess(context, 'Debt deleted');
  }

  void _showCreditCardAccount(BuildContext context, String accountName) {
    final accountsAsync = ref.read(accountListProvider);
    accountsAsync.whenData((accounts) {
      final creditCardAccount = accounts.firstWhere(
        (account) =>
            account.type == 'Credit Card' && account.name == accountName,
        orElse: () => accounts.firstWhere(
          (account) => account.type == 'Credit Card',
        ),
      );
      Navigator.of(context).push(
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (context) => AccountDetailScreen(account: creditCardAccount),
        ),
      );
    });
  }
}

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

    // Calculate Net Worth: I have - I owe

    // Calculate percentages for bars

  Widget _buildToggleButton(
    BuildContext context,
    String label,
    bool isSelected,
    VoidCallback onTap,
    Color color,
  ) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? color : Colors.grey.shade300,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Center(
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.normal,
                  color: isSelected ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIHaveDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    AsyncValue<List<Account>> accountsAsync,
    double total,
  ) {
    return accountsAsync.when(
      data: (accounts) {
        // Filter out Credit Card accounts
        final regularAccounts = accounts
            .where((a) => a.type.toLowerCase() != 'credit card')
            .toList();

        if (regularAccounts.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }

        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
          ),
          child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: () {
                // TODO: Navigate to accounts screen
              },
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.account_balance,
                    color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                    size: 28,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'Accounts',
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ').format(total),
                          style: Theme.of(context)
                              .textTheme
                              .bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Icon(
                    Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                    color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                    size: 24,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
      loading: () => const SizedBox.shrink(),
      error: (_, __) => const SizedBox.shrink(),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIOweDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    double total,
  ) {
    final creditCardDebtAsync = ref.watch(debtListProvider('i_owe'));
    final creditCardDebt = creditCardDebtAsync.when(
      data: (debts) {
        return debts
            .where((d) => d.note == 'Credit Card Debt')
            .fold<double>(
              0.0,
              (sum, debt) => sum + (debt.amount - debt.paidAmount),
            );
      },
      loading: () => 0.0,
      error: (_, __) => 0.0,
    );

    final regularDebtTotal = total - creditCardDebt;

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          if (creditCardDebt > 0)
            Card(
              child: InkWell(
                onTap: () {
                  // TODO: Navigate to credit cards
                },
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppDesignTokens.space16),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.credit_card,
                        color: Colors.orange.shade700,
                        size: 32,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: AppDesignTokens.space16),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              'Credit cards',
                              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 4),
                            Text(
                              NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                                  .format(creditCardDebt),
                              style: Theme.of(context)
                                  .textTheme
                                  .bodyMedium
                                  ?.copyWith(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      Icon(
                        Icons.chevron_right,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade400,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (creditCardDebt > 0 && regularDebtTotal > 0)
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space12),
          if (regularDebtTotal > 0)
            Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppDesignTokens.space16),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                      color: Colors.red.shade700,
                      size: 32,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: AppDesignTokens.space16),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            'Other debts',
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Text(
                            NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                                .format(regularDebtTotal),
                            style: Theme.of(context)
                                .textTheme
                                .bodyMedium
                                ?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDebtList(String type) {
    if (type == 'i_have') {
      // Show accounts list
      final accountsAsync = ref.watch(accountListProvider);
      return accountsAsync.when(
        data: (accounts) {
          final regularAccounts = accounts
              .where((a) => a.type.toLowerCase() != 'credit card')
              .toList();

          if (regularAccounts.isEmpty) {
            return RefreshIndicator(
              onRefresh: () async {
                ref.invalidate(accountListProvider);
              },
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                child: SizedBox(
                  height: 400,
                  child: EmptyStateWidget(
                    icon: Icons.account_balance,
                    title: 'No accounts yet.',
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          }

          return RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: () async {
              ref.invalidate(accountListProvider);
            },
            child: ListView.builder(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
                vertical: AppDesignTokens.space8,
              ),
              physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              cacheExtent: 500,
              itemCount: regularAccounts.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final account = regularAccounts[index];
                return Card(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: AppDesignTokens.space8),
                  child: ListTile(
                    leading: Icon(
                      Icons.account_balance,
                      color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                    ),
                    title: Text(account.name),
                    subtitle: Text(account.type),
                    trailing: Text(
                      NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                          .format(account.balance),
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: account.balance >= 0
                                ? Colors.green
                                : Colors.red,
                          ),
                    ),
                    onTap: () {
                      Navigator.of(context).push(
                        MaterialPageRoute(
                          builder: (context) =>
                              AccountDetailScreen(account: account),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          );
        },
        loading: () => SkeletonList.cards(itemCount: 6),
        error: (error, stack) => ErrorStateWidget(
          message: error.toString(),
          onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(accountListProvider),
        ),
      );
    }

    // Show debts list
    final debtsAsync = ref.watch(debtListProvider(type));

    return debtsAsync.when(
      data: (debts) {
        if (debts.isEmpty) {
          return RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: () async {
              ref.invalidate(debtListProvider(type));
            },
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              child: SizedBox(
                height: 400,
                child: EmptyStateWidget(
                  icon: Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                  title: type == 'i_owe'
                      ? 'No debts to pay. Great job!'
                      : 'No one owes you money.',
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }

        return RefreshIndicator(
          onRefresh: () async {
            ref.invalidate(debtListProvider(type));
          },
          child: ListView.builder(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
              vertical: AppDesignTokens.space8,
            ),
            physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
            cacheExtent: 500,
            itemCount: debts.length,
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final debt = debts[index];
              final isCreditCardDebt = debt.note == 'Credit Card Debt';

              return Dismissible(
                key: Key('debt_${debt.id ?? 'credit_card_${debt.person}'}'),
                direction: isCreditCardDebt
                    ? DismissDirection.none
                    : DismissDirection.endToStart,
                background: Container(
                  alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd,
                  padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(
                      end: AppDesignTokens.space20),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                    borderRadius:
                        BorderRadius.circular(AppDesignTokens.radiusMedium),
                  ),
                  child: Icon(
                    Icons.delete,
                    color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onError,
                    size: 32,
                  ),
                ),
                confirmDismiss: isCreditCardDebt
                    ? null
                    : (direction) async {
                        return await showDialog<bool>(
                              context: context,
                              builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
                                title: const Text('Delete Debt'),
                                content: const Text(
                                  'Are you sure you want to delete this debt?',
                                ),
                                actions: [
                                  TextButton(
                                    onPressed: () =>
                                        Navigator.of(context).pop(false),
                                    child: const Text('Cancel'),
                                  ),
                                  TextButton(
                                    onPressed: () =>
                                        Navigator.of(context).pop(true),
                                    style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                                      foregroundColor:
                                          Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
                                    ),
                                    child: const Text('Delete'),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ) ??
                            false;
                      },
                onDismissed: isCreditCardDebt
                    ? null
                    : (direction) {
                        _deleteDebt(context, debt);
                      },
                child: DebtListItem(
                  debt: debt,
                  onTap: () {
                    if (isCreditCardDebt) {
                      _showCreditCardAccount(context, debt.person);
                    } else {
                      _showDebtDetail(context, debt);
                    }
                  },
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        );
      },
      loading: () => SkeletonList.cards(itemCount: 6),
      error: (error, stack) => ErrorStateWidget(
        message: error.toString(),
        onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(debtListProvider(type)),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showAddDebtDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => const AddDebtDialog(),
    );
  }

  void _showDebtDetail(BuildContext context, Debt debt) {
    context.push(
      AppRoutes.debtDetail,
      extra: debt,
    );
  }

  void _deleteDebt(BuildContext context, Debt debt) {
    if (debt.id == null) return;

    ref
        .read(debtNotifierProvider.notifier)
        .deleteDebtEntry(debt.id!, debt.type);
    FeedbackService.showSuccess(context, 'Debt deleted');
  }

  void _showCreditCardAccount(BuildContext context, String accountName) {
    final accountsAsync = ref.read(accountListProvider);
    accountsAsync.whenData((accounts) {
      final creditCardAccount = accounts.firstWhere(
        (account) =>
            account.type == 'Credit Card' && account.name == accountName,
        orElse: () => accounts.firstWhere(
          (account) => account.type == 'Credit Card',
        ),
      );
      Navigator.of(context).push(
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (context) => AccountDetailScreen(account: creditCardAccount),
        ),
      );
    });
  }
}
