            // Top Section - Overview with bars
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppDesignTokens.space16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  // Horizontal bars
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        flex: (iHavePercentage * 100).round().clamp(1, 100),
                        child: Container(
                          height: 8,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.green,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
                              topLeft: const Radius.circular(4),
                              bottomLeft: const Radius.circular(4),
                              topRight: iOwePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                              bottomRight: iOwePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Expanded(
                        flex: (iOwePercentage * 100).round().clamp(1, 100),
                        child: Container(
                          height: 8,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.red,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
                              topRight: const Radius.circular(4),
                              bottomRight: const Radius.circular(4),
                              topLeft: iHavePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                              bottomLeft: iHavePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  // I have and I owe amounts
                  Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            width: 10,
                            height: 10,
                            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                              color: Colors.green,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            'I have',
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            _formatCurrency(iHave),
                            style: Theme.of(context)
                                .textTheme
                                .bodyMedium
                                ?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            width: 10,
                            height: 10,
                            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                              color: Colors.red,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            'I owe',
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                                .format(iOwe),
                            style: Theme.of(context)
                                .textTheme
                                .bodyMedium
                                ?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),
                  // Net Worth
                  Center(
                    child: Column(
                      children: [
                        Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              'Net Worth',
                              style: Theme.of(context)
                                  .textTheme
                                  .titleMedium
                                  ?.copyWith(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                  ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 6),
                            Icon(
                              Icons.info_outline,
                              size: 18,
                              color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        Text(
                          NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                              .format(netWorth),

                              .textTheme

                              ?.copyWith(

                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
            // Toggle Buttons
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: _buildToggleButton(
                      context,
                      'I have',
                      _selectedView == 'i_have',
                      () => setState(() => _selectedView = 'i_have'),
                      Colors.green,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: AppDesignTokens.space12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: _buildToggleButton(
                      context,
                      'I owe',
                      _selectedView == 'i_owe',
                      () => setState(() => _selectedView = 'i_owe'),
                      Colors.red,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
            // Total amount card
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
              ),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      'Total amount in ${DateFormat('d MMM yyyy').format(DateTime.now())}',
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(
                      NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ').format(
                        _selectedView == 'i_have' ? iHave : iOwe,
                      ),
                      style: Theme.of(context)
                          .textTheme
                          .titleLarge
                          ?.copyWith(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
            // Detail Cards
            if (_selectedView == 'i_have')
              _buildIHaveDetails(context, accountsAsync, iHave)
            else
              _buildIOweDetails(context, iOwe),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
        onPressed: () => _showAddDebtDialog(context),
        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildToggleButton(
    BuildContext context,
    String label,
    bool isSelected,
    VoidCallback onTap,
    Color color,
  ) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),

        ),

                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
            // Toggle Buttons
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: _buildToggleButton(
                      context,
                      'I have',
                      _selectedView == 'i_have',
                      () => setState(() => _selectedView = 'i_have'),
                      Colors.green,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: AppDesignTokens.space12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: _buildToggleButton(
                      context,
                      'I owe',
                      _selectedView == 'i_owe',
                      () => setState(() => _selectedView = 'i_owe'),
                      Colors.red,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
            // Total amount card
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
              ),

                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,

                          ?.copyWith(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
            // Detail Cards
            if (_selectedView == 'i_have')
              _buildIHaveDetails(context, accountsAsync, iHave)
            else
              _buildIOweDetails(context, iOwe),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
        onPressed: () => _showAddDebtDialog(context),
        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildToggleButton(
    BuildContext context,
    String label,
    bool isSelected,
    VoidCallback onTap,
    Color color,
  ) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? color : Colors.grey.shade300,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Center(
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.normal,
                  color: isSelected ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIHaveDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    AsyncValue<List<Account>> accountsAsync,
    double total,
  ) {
    return accountsAsync.when(
      data: (accounts) {
        // Filter out Credit Card accounts
        final regularAccounts = accounts
            .where((a) => a.type.toLowerCase() != 'credit card')
            .toList();

        if (regularAccounts.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }

        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
          ),
          child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: () {
                // TODO: Navigate to accounts screen
              },
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.account_balance,
                    color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                    size: 28,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'Accounts',
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ').format(total),
                          style: Theme.of(context)
                              .textTheme
                              .bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Icon(
                    Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                    color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                    size: 24,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
      loading: () => const SizedBox.shrink(),
      error: (_, __) => const SizedBox.shrink(),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIOweDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    double total,
  ) {
    final creditCardDebtAsync = ref.watch(debtListProvider('i_owe'));
    final creditCardDebt = creditCardDebtAsync.when(
      data: (debts) {
        return debts
            .where((d) => d.note == 'Credit Card Debt')
            .fold<double>(
              0.0,
              (sum, debt) => sum + (debt.amount - debt.paidAmount),
            );
      },
      loading: () => 0.0,
      error: (_, __) => 0.0,
    );

    final regularDebtTotal = total - creditCardDebt;

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          if (creditCardDebt > 0)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: InkWell(
                  onTap: () {
                    // TODO: Navigate to credit cards
                  },
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.credit_card,
                        color: Colors.orange.shade700,
                        size: 28,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 16),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              'Credit cards',
                              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                            ),
                            Text(
                              NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                                  .format(creditCardDebt),
                              style: Theme.of(context)
                                  .textTheme
                                  .bodyMedium
                                  ?.copyWith(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Icon(
                        Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                        size: 24,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (regularDebtTotal > 0)
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                    color: Colors.red.shade700,
                    size: 28,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'Other debts',
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                              .format(regularDebtTotal),
                          style: Theme.of(context)
                              .textTheme
                              .bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }


  void _showAddDebtDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => const AddDebtDialog(),
    );
  }

}

  String _selectedView = 'i_owe'; // 'i_owe' or 'owed_to_me'

  // Helper method to format currency with negative sign next to number
  String _formatCurrency(double amount) {
    final formatted = NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ').format(amount.abs());
    if (amount < 0) {
      // Replace "EGP " with "-EGP " or put "-" before the number
      return formatted.replaceFirst('EGP ', '-EGP ');
    }
    return formatted;
  }

    final iHaveTotal = ref.watch(totalBalanceProvider);
    final iOweTotal = ref.watch(totalIOweProvider);

    final iHave = iHaveTotal ?? 0.0;
    final iOwe = iOweTotal ?? 0.0;
    final netWorth = iHave - iOwe;

    // Calculate percentages for bars
    final total = iHave + iOwe;
    final iHavePercentage = total > 0 ? (iHave / total) : 0.0;
    final iOwePercentage = total > 0 ? (iOwe / total) : 0.0;

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(

                        child: Container(

                          decoration: BoxDecoration(

                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
                              topLeft: const Radius.circular(4),
                              bottomLeft: const Radius.circular(4),
                              topRight: iOwePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                              bottomRight: iOwePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Expanded(
                        flex: (iOwePercentage * 100).round().clamp(1, 100),
                        child: Container(
                          height: 8,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.red,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
                              topRight: const Radius.circular(4),
                              bottomRight: const Radius.circular(4),
                              topLeft: iHavePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                              bottomLeft: iHavePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  // I have and I owe amounts
                  Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            width: 10,
                            height: 10,
                            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                              color: Colors.green,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            'I have',
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            _formatCurrency(iHave),
                            style: Theme.of(context)
                                .textTheme
                                .bodyMedium
                                ?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            width: 10,
                            height: 10,
                            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                              color: Colors.red,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            'I owe',
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),

                                .bodyMedium
                                ?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),

                  Center(

                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),

            // Toggle Buttons
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [

                    child: _buildToggleButton(
                      context,

                      () => setState(() => _selectedView = 'i_have'),

                  ),

                  Expanded(
                    child: _buildToggleButton(
                      context,
                      'I owe',
                      _selectedView == 'i_owe',
                      () => setState(() => _selectedView = 'i_owe'),
                      Colors.red,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),

                ),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(

                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(

            else

            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(

        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildToggleButton(
    BuildContext context,
    String label,
    bool isSelected,
    VoidCallback onTap,
    Color color,

      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? color : Colors.grey.shade300,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

        child: Center(
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.normal,
                  color: isSelected ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIHaveDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    AsyncValue<List<Account>> accountsAsync,
    double total,
  ) {
    return accountsAsync.when(
      data: (accounts) {
        // Filter out Credit Card accounts
        final regularAccounts = accounts
            .where((a) => a.type.toLowerCase() != 'credit card')
            .toList();

        if (regularAccounts.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }

        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
          ),
          child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: () {
                // TODO: Navigate to accounts screen
              },
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.account_balance,
                    color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                    size: 28,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'Accounts',
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ').format(total),
                          style: Theme.of(context)
                              .textTheme
                              .bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Icon(
                    Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                    color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                    size: 24,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
      loading: () => const SizedBox.shrink(),
      error: (_, __) => const SizedBox.shrink(),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIOweDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    double total,
  ) {
    final creditCardDebtAsync = ref.watch(debtListProvider('i_owe'));
    final creditCardDebt = creditCardDebtAsync.when(
      data: (debts) {
        return debts
            .where((d) => d.note == 'Credit Card Debt')
            .fold<double>(
              0.0,
              (sum, debt) => sum + (debt.amount - debt.paidAmount),
            );
      },
      loading: () => 0.0,
      error: (_, __) => 0.0,
    );

    final regularDebtTotal = total - creditCardDebt;

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          if (creditCardDebt > 0)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: InkWell(
                  onTap: () {
                    // TODO: Navigate to credit cards
                  },
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.credit_card,
                        color: Colors.orange.shade700,
                        size: 28,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 16),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              'Credit cards',
                              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                            ),
                            Text(
                              NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                                  .format(creditCardDebt),
                              style: Theme.of(context)
                                  .textTheme
                                  .bodyMedium
                                  ?.copyWith(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Icon(
                        Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                        size: 24,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (regularDebtTotal > 0)
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                    color: Colors.red.shade700,
                    size: 28,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'Other debts',
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                              .format(regularDebtTotal),
                          style: Theme.of(context)
                              .textTheme
                              .bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }


  void _showAddDebtDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => const AddDebtDialog(),
    );
  }

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import 'package:life_tracker/core/constants/app_design_tokens.dart';
import 'package:life_tracker/features/finance/domain/entities/account.dart';
import 'package:life_tracker/features/finance/presentation/providers/account_provider.dart';
import 'package:life_tracker/features/finance/presentation/providers/debt_provider.dart';
import 'package:life_tracker/features/finance/presentation/widgets/add_debt_dialog.dart';

class DebtsScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const DebtsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<DebtsScreen> createState() => _DebtsScreenState();
}

class _DebtsScreenState extends ConsumerState<DebtsScreen> {
  String _selectedView = 'i_owe'; // 'i_owe' or 'owed_to_me'

  // Helper method to format currency with negative sign next to number
  String _formatCurrency(double amount) {
    final formatted = NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ').format(amount.abs());
    if (amount < 0) {
      // Replace "EGP " with "-EGP " or put "-" before the number
      return formatted.replaceFirst('EGP ', '-EGP ');
    }
    return formatted;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final iHaveTotal = ref.watch(totalBalanceProvider);
    final iOweTotal = ref.watch(totalIOweProvider);
    final accountsAsync = ref.watch(accountListProvider);

    // Calculate Net Worth: I have - I owe
    final iHave = iHaveTotal ?? 0.0;
    final iOwe = iOweTotal ?? 0.0;
    final netWorth = iHave - iOwe;

    // Calculate percentages for bars
    final total = iHave + iOwe;
    final iHavePercentage = total > 0 ? (iHave / total) : 0.0;
    final iOwePercentage = total > 0 ? (iOwe / total) : 0.0;

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Debts'),
      ),
      body: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            // Top Section - Overview with bars
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppDesignTokens.space16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  // Horizontal bars
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        flex: (iHavePercentage * 100).round().clamp(1, 100),
                        child: Container(
                          height: 8,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.green,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
                              topLeft: const Radius.circular(4),
                              bottomLeft: const Radius.circular(4),
                              topRight: iOwePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                              bottomRight: iOwePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Expanded(
                        flex: (iOwePercentage * 100).round().clamp(1, 100),
                        child: Container(
                          height: 8,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.red,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
                              topRight: const Radius.circular(4),
                              bottomRight: const Radius.circular(4),
                              topLeft: iHavePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                              bottomLeft: iHavePercentage == 0
                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  // I have and I owe amounts
                  Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            width: 10,
                            height: 10,
                            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                              color: Colors.green,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            'I have',
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            _formatCurrency(iHave),
                            style: Theme.of(context)
                                .textTheme
                                .bodyMedium
                                ?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            width: 10,
                            height: 10,
                            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                              color: Colors.red,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            'I owe',
                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            _formatCurrency(iOwe),
                            style: Theme.of(context)
                                .textTheme
                                .bodyMedium
                                ?.copyWith(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),
                  // Net Worth
                  Center(
                    child: Column(
                      children: [
                        Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              'Net Worth',
                              style: Theme.of(context)
                                  .textTheme
                                  .titleMedium
                                  ?.copyWith(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                  ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 6),
                            Icon(
                              Icons.info_outline,
                              size: 18,
                              color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        Text(
                          _formatCurrency(netWorth),
                          style: Theme.of(context)
                              .textTheme
                              .headlineLarge
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: netWorth >= 0 ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
            // Toggle Buttons
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: _buildToggleButton(
                      context,
                      'I have',
                      _selectedView == 'i_have',
                      () => setState(() => _selectedView = 'i_have'),
                      Colors.green,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: AppDesignTokens.space12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: _buildToggleButton(
                      context,
                      'I owe',
                      _selectedView == 'i_owe',
                      () => setState(() => _selectedView = 'i_owe'),
                      Colors.red,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
            // Total amount card
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
              ),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      'Total amount in ${DateFormat('d MMM yyyy').format(DateTime.now())}',
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(
                      _formatCurrency(
                        _selectedView == 'i_have' ? iHave : iOwe,
                      ),
                      style: Theme.of(context)
                          .textTheme
                          .titleLarge
                          ?.copyWith(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
            // Detail Cards
            if (_selectedView == 'i_have')
              _buildIHaveDetails(context, accountsAsync, iHave)
            else
              _buildIOweDetails(context, iOwe),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
        onPressed: () => _showAddDebtDialog(context),
        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildToggleButton(
    BuildContext context,
    String label,
    bool isSelected,
    VoidCallback onTap,
    Color color,
  ) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? color : Colors.grey.shade300,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Center(
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.normal,
                  color: isSelected ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIHaveDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    AsyncValue<List<Account>> accountsAsync,
    double total,
  ) {
    return accountsAsync.when(
      data: (accounts) {
        // Filter out Credit Card accounts
        final regularAccounts = accounts
            .where((a) => a.type.toLowerCase() != 'credit card')
            .toList();

        if (regularAccounts.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }

        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
          ),
          child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: () {
                // TODO: Navigate to accounts screen
              },
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.account_balance,
                    color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                    size: 28,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'Accounts',
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          _formatCurrency(total),
                          style: Theme.of(context)
                              .textTheme
                              .bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Icon(
                    Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                    color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                    size: 24,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
      loading: () => const SizedBox.shrink(),
      error: (_, __) => const SizedBox.shrink(),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIOweDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    double total,
  ) {
    final creditCardDebtAsync = ref.watch(debtListProvider('i_owe'));
    final creditCardDebt = creditCardDebtAsync.when(
      data: (debts) {
        return debts
            .where((d) => d.note == 'Credit Card Debt')
            .fold<double>(
              0.0,
              (sum, debt) => sum + (debt.amount - debt.paidAmount),
            );
      },
      loading: () => 0.0,
      error: (_, __) => 0.0,
    );

    final regularDebtTotal = total - creditCardDebt;

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          if (creditCardDebt > 0)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: InkWell(
                  onTap: () {
                    // TODO: Navigate to credit cards
                  },
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.credit_card,
                        color: Colors.orange.shade700,
                        size: 28,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 16),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              'Credit cards',
                              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                            ),
                            Text(
                              _formatCurrency(creditCardDebt),
                              style: Theme.of(context)
                                  .textTheme
                                  .bodyMedium
                                  ?.copyWith(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Icon(
                        Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                        size: 24,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (regularDebtTotal > 0)
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                    color: Colors.red.shade700,
                    size: 28,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'Other debts',
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          NumberFormat.currency(symbol: 'EGP ')
                              .format(regularDebtTotal),
                          style: Theme.of(context)
                              .textTheme
                              .bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }


  void _showAddDebtDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => const AddDebtDialog(),
    );
  }

}

  Widget _buildToggleButton(
    BuildContext context,
    String label,
    bool isSelected,
    VoidCallback onTap,
    Color color,
  ) {

      onTap: onTap,

            label,

                  color: isSelected ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIHaveDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    AsyncValue<List<Account>> accountsAsync,
    double total,
  ) {
    return accountsAsync.when(
      data: (accounts) {
        // Filter out Credit Card accounts
        final regularAccounts = accounts
            .where((a) => a.type.toLowerCase() != 'credit card')
            .toList();

        if (regularAccounts.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();

        return Padding(

    final creditCardDebt = creditCardDebtAsync.when(

                          style: Theme.of(context)
                              .textTheme
                              .bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );

  void _showAddDebtDialog(BuildContext context) {

    );

}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

  String _selectedView = 'i_owe'; // 'i_owe' or 'owed_to_me'

  // Helper method to format currency with negative sign next to number
  String _formatCurrency(double amount) {
    final numberFormat = NumberFormat('#,##0.00');
    final formattedNumber = numberFormat.format(amount.abs());
    final sign = amount < 0 ? '-' : '';
    return 'EGP $sign$formattedNumber';
  }

                                  : Radius.zero,

                      ),
                    ],
                  ),

                  Row(

                    children: [

                          const SizedBox(width: 8),

```

تم التعديل. الآن علامة السالب تظهر بجانب الرقم مباشرة وليس بجانب "EGP".

**مثال:**
- قبل: `-EGP 24,350.73`
- بعد: `EGP -24,350.73`

**التغييرات:**
- إضافة دالة مساعدة `_formatCurrency` لتنسيق المبالغ
- استخدام `NumberFormat('#,##0.00')` لتنسيق الرقم فقط
- إضافة علامة السالب قبل الرقم مباشرة إذا كانت القيمة سالبة
- تطبيق الدالة على جميع المبالغ في الشاشة

الكود يمر بدون أخطاء.

---

**User**

ممكن نعمل الجزء العلوي داخل container

---

**Cursor**

وضع الجزء العلوي داخل container:

  Widget _buildToggleButton(
    BuildContext context,
    String label,
    bool isSelected,
    VoidCallback onTap,
    Color color,
  ) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? color : Colors.grey.shade300,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Center(
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.normal,
                  color: isSelected ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIHaveDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    AsyncValue<List<Account>> accountsAsync,
    double total,
  ) {
    return accountsAsync.when(
      data: (accounts) {
        // Filter out Credit Card accounts
        final regularAccounts = accounts
            .where((a) => a.type.toLowerCase() != 'credit card')
            .toList();

        if (regularAccounts.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }

        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
          ),
          child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: () {
                // TODO: Navigate to accounts screen
              },
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.account_balance,
                    color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                    size: 28,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'Accounts',
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          _formatCurrency(total),
                          style: Theme.of(context)
                              .textTheme
                              .bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Icon(
                    Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                    color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                    size: 24,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
      loading: () => const SizedBox.shrink(),
      error: (_, __) => const SizedBox.shrink(),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIOweDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    double total,
  ) {
    final creditCardDebtAsync = ref.watch(debtListProvider('i_owe'));
    final creditCardDebt = creditCardDebtAsync.when(
      data: (debts) {
        return debts
            .where((d) => d.note == 'Credit Card Debt')
            .fold<double>(
              0.0,
              (sum, debt) => sum + (debt.amount - debt.paidAmount),
            );
      },
      loading: () => 0.0,
      error: (_, __) => 0.0,
    );

    final regularDebtTotal = total - creditCardDebt;

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          if (creditCardDebt > 0)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: InkWell(
                  onTap: () {
                    // TODO: Navigate to credit cards
                  },
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.credit_card,
                        color: Colors.orange.shade700,
                        size: 28,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 16),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              'Credit cards',
                              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                            ),
                            Text(
                              _formatCurrency(creditCardDebt),
                              style: Theme.of(context)
                                  .textTheme
                                  .bodyMedium
                                  ?.copyWith(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Icon(
                        Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                        size: 24,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (regularDebtTotal > 0)
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                    color: Colors.red.shade700,
                    size: 28,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'Other debts',
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          _formatCurrency(regularDebtTotal),
                          style: Theme.of(context)
                              .textTheme
                              .bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }


  void _showAddDebtDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => const AddDebtDialog(),
    );
  }

  String _selectedView = 'i_owe'; // 'i_owe' or 'owed_to_me'

  // Helper method to format currency with negative sign next to number
  String _formatCurrency(double amount) {
    final numberFormat = NumberFormat('#,##0.00');
    final formattedNumber = numberFormat.format(amount.abs());
    final sign = amount < 0 ? '-' : '';
    return 'EGP $sign$formattedNumber';
  }

    final iHaveTotal = ref.watch(totalBalanceProvider);

    final iOwe = iOweTotal ?? 0.0;
    final netWorth = iHave - iOwe;

    // Calculate percentages for bars

}

class _DebtsScreenState extends ConsumerState<DebtsScreen> {

  String _formatCurrency(double amount) {

    final iOwe = iOweTotal ?? 0.0;

    final iOwePercentage = total > 0 ? (iOwe / total) : 0.0;

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Debts'),
      ),
      body: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,

            // Top Section - Overview with bars

                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,

                                  ? const Radius.circular(4)
                                  : Radius.zero,

                                  : Radius.zero,

                              'Net Worth',
                              style: Theme.of(context)
                                  .textTheme
                                  .titleMedium
                                  ?.copyWith(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                  ),

                            const SizedBox(width: 6),
                            Icon(
                              Icons.info_outline,
                              size: 18,
                              color: Colors.grey.shade600,

                    child: _buildToggleButton(
                      context,
                      'I owe',

                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),

                      'Total amount in ${DateFormat('d MMM yyyy').format(DateTime.now())}',

                    ),

                      _formatCurrency(
                        _selectedView == 'i_have' ? iHave : iOwe,
                      ),
                      style: Theme.of(context)
                          .textTheme
                          .titleLarge
                          ?.copyWith(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,

                ),

            ),
            const SizedBox(height: AppDesignTokens.space16),
            // Detail Cards
            if (_selectedView == 'i_have')
              _buildIHaveDetails(context, accountsAsync, iHave)
            else
              _buildIOweDetails(context, iOwe),

        onPressed: () => _showAddDebtDialog(context),
        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
      ),
    );

  Widget _buildToggleButton(
    BuildContext context,
    String label,
    bool isSelected,
    VoidCallback onTap,
    Color color,
  ) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? color : Colors.grey.shade300,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Center(
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
                  fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.normal,
                  color: isSelected ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIHaveDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    AsyncValue<List<Account>> accountsAsync,
    double total,
  ) {
    return accountsAsync.when(
      data: (accounts) {
        // Filter out Credit Card accounts
        final regularAccounts = accounts
            .where((a) => a.type.toLowerCase() != 'credit card')
            .toList();

        if (regularAccounts.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }

        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
          ),
          child: Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: () {
                // TODO: Navigate to accounts screen
              },
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.account_balance,
                    color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                    size: 28,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'Accounts',
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          _formatCurrency(total),
                          style: Theme.of(context)
                              .textTheme
                              .bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Icon(
                    Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                    color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                    size: 24,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
      loading: () => const SizedBox.shrink(),
      error: (_, __) => const SizedBox.shrink(),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIOweDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    double total,
  ) {
    final creditCardDebtAsync = ref.watch(debtListProvider('i_owe'));
    final creditCardDebt = creditCardDebtAsync.when(
      data: (debts) {
        return debts
            .where((d) => d.note == 'Credit Card Debt')
            .fold<double>(
              0.0,
              (sum, debt) => sum + (debt.amount - debt.paidAmount),
            );
      },
      loading: () => 0.0,
      error: (_, __) => 0.0,
    );

    final regularDebtTotal = total - creditCardDebt;

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          if (creditCardDebt > 0)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: InkWell(
                  onTap: () {
                    // TODO: Navigate to credit cards
                  },
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.credit_card,
                        color: Colors.orange.shade700,
                        size: 28,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 16),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              'Credit cards',
                              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                            ),
                            Text(
                              _formatCurrency(creditCardDebt),
                              style: Theme.of(context)
                                  .textTheme
                                  .bodyMedium
                                  ?.copyWith(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Icon(
                        Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                        size: 24,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (regularDebtTotal > 0)
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                    color: Colors.red.shade700,
                    size: 28,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'Other debts',
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          _formatCurrency(regularDebtTotal),
                          style: Theme.of(context)
                              .textTheme
                              .bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }


  void _showAddDebtDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => const AddDebtDialog(),
    );
  }

}

                        Text(

            ),
          ),
        );
      },
      loading: () => const SizedBox.shrink(),
      error: (_, __) => const SizedBox.shrink(),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildIOweDetails(
    BuildContext context,
    double total,
  ) {
    final creditCardDebtAsync = ref.watch(debtListProvider('i_owe'));
    final creditCardDebt = creditCardDebtAsync.when(
      data: (debts) {
        return debts
            .where((d) => d.note == 'Credit Card Debt')
            .fold<double>(
              0.0,
              (sum, debt) => sum + (debt.amount - debt.paidAmount),
            );
      },
      loading: () => 0.0,
      error: (_, __) => 0.0,

    final regularDebtTotal = total - creditCardDebt;

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: AppDesignTokens.space16,
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          if (creditCardDebt > 0)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: InkWell(
                  onTap: () {
                    // TODO: Navigate to credit cards
                  },
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.credit_card,
                        color: Colors.orange.shade700,
                        size: 28,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 16),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              'Credit cards',
                              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                            ),
                            Text(
                              _formatCurrency(creditCardDebt),
                              style: Theme.of(context)
                                  .textTheme
                                  .bodyMedium
                                  ?.copyWith(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Icon(
                        Icons.keyboard_arrow_down,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                        size: 24,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (regularDebtTotal > 0)
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.account_balance_wallet,
                    color: Colors.red.shade700,
                    size: 28,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'Other debts',
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          _formatCurrency(regularDebtTotal),
                          style: Theme.of(context)
                              .textTheme
                              .bodyMedium
                              ?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }


  void _showAddDebtDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => const AddDebtDialog(),
    );
  }
